reviews.text:
I took my cat here for a checkup because they had many positive reviews. However, after my experience, I realized they only have so many 5-star reviews because they offer free gifts in exchange for a positive review. So please do not be misled as I was!

This vet is dirty. And I mean the dirtiest vet I have ever been to. It smells unpleasant, there is lots of uncleaned pet hair, and dirt and grime are everywhere. During the appointment, they continuously misgendered my cat after I explained that she is, in fact, female. The entire experience felt very unprofessional, and my biggest complaint is that they administered shots to my cat without asking me for permission or even explaining what they were administering. They were not eager to answer any questions, and everything felt rushed. It did not feel like a thorough checkup at all.

I would not recommend taking your animal here.

My only positive experience was with the woman at the front desk. She was very kind.

Our pup Roscoe swallowed a small nose ring & was able to get x-rays on such short notice. Dr Sarah & the rest of the team took such good care of him & were so kind and transparent throughout the whole process. Very grateful they are here for our pets.
Compassionate, knowledgeable, and exceptional are the words I have to describe Dr Sara and her team! Thank you all for being so supportive kind and loving during our visits.
Kind and compassionate staff, I will definitely be making them my pets primary care! Thanks to everyone who help care for our cat!

My cat Zoe's nails were caught under a bed box spring which many times I tried to keep her away from, and I panicked because she was crying in pain and once we got her out under the bed she was limping, so my first thought was a broken leg or injury to her paw. Her primary vet was closed since this happened around 6:30 pm. My first thought was call medvet and take her there  but then I remembered Paws and Feathers and had read their reviews. I called them right away and they were booked due to surgeries that night but the amazing person I spoke to on the phone was able to talk to a vet and they told me to come in. Keep in mind I'm in panic mode, Zoe is almost a year old. From the moment I walked in I was welcomed with compassion. The Dr and the vet assistant in which I don't get their name and the receptionist were all amazing and caring and heard my concerns. Thankfully Zoe just had some nail injury' and will be fine. The vet didn't  request any overpriced X-rays or blood work, she examined her, and even clipped her nails. They even asked for a hug before I left. This place is so caring and you can tell they care about animals and love what they do. I was talking so much they probably thought this lady is 🤣 crazy. Thank you so much for taking care of My Zoe and giving me a piece of mind and especially on a busy night and on such short notice. I will forever be grateful. You all are amazing.
I wouldn't come back to a place that can't tell me whats wrong after multiple tests, then prescribes something dangerous as a "maybe it'll work" just to kill your furbaby in less than 24h
I love this place... and Dr. Sarah... she saved my boy Frankie a couple times... very gentle nature... I just adore her... Plus office staff is very friendly... especially ANDY!!!

We’ve been coming to Dr. Sarah for quite some time I want to say since 2018/2019, used to live up north and moved a bit south and there’s no one else we’d bring our pets to. The staff is always friendly and accommodating and very professional and Dr. Sarah is such a great vet and good at what she does our dogs are always very comfortable around her when we come in for visits.

Dr. Sarah and her team are amazing, I can tell they are passionate about animals and care about your pet rather than money. They are always happy to answer questions. I wouldn’t want to take my bird anywhere else. I have had good experiences with both regular appointments and an emergency visit.
Most friendly staff, Doctor is amazing, through examination, and affordable pricing. Love this place and so does my Bella
Amazing team ! I had an emergency with my little guy and they saw his fast and worked with me on the rates.  I will be bringing my dog back here for ever

This place has been great.  We started coming here because they were the only place with openings when we found a sick cat. They took great care of her. They have a discount on dental cleanings every year so we started bringing our dog here as well. They’ve been willing to give discounts if you ask for them which is really nice. My daughter had a cancer stricken cat put down here as well. I do recommend it to other people.
Amazing people, my dog is doing fantastic after his oral surgery.
Dr. Sarah is so amazing. She has helped me with my chameleon and my two dogs highly recommended😊

5/5! After having a terrible experience with another vet, I decided to make an appointment and bring my kitten to this local veterinary that was near my area. The staff was really nice and professional. They treated my kitten really well and they found out what she had. So grateful for people like them, they truly are the best.
I would recommend this place to anyone with a pet.
Love this vet! They're quick, helpful and kind.

My dog needed immediate help, every clinic kept neglecting due to the fact my dog was aggressive and vicious. I found this clinic on Google and called, they had no problem with treating my dog. Although my dog was hard to handle they still remained patient and got the help my dog needed. I can tell they care a lot about their patients. I highly recommend you come to Paws and Feathers, they will take good care of your animals.

went in thru the bk entrance stood at counter for 5min employee on hes cell phone  didn't even realize someone was ther
then when he did we were told No Vet in facility we were turned away so we headed to another place that did take us but my fur bby was very ill e.r situation.
Nice people decent price wonderful clinic

I was out of options I called so many places and then I found Paws and Feathers took  my baby for a consultation and the next week for his teeth cleaning price was the best I found very reasonable. They were very kind with my baby and his teeth look amazing he was in so much pain and was so unhappy people don't realize what Tarter does to their teeth and gums I'm so happy I took him . I applied for Cherry to make monthly payments for the service and  I was happy I was approved . Sometimes it's hard for us Pet Parents but if you do your research you will find a location like Paws and Feathers . Thank you 🐾🐾
Dr. Sarah and her staff are amazing! We can’t thank her enough and wish we found paws and feathers earlier!

I have been coming to see Dr. Sara for over a decade for all of my pets. She is very knowledgeable and truly cares about every pet she sees. I’ve referred her to family and friends and they have all had great experiences here. Highly recommend.

Brought my dog Koby here for care and was blown away by the compassion and empathy shown by the entire staff. They answered all of my questions, and truly treated my furry family member as if he were their own. The front desk team is also incredibly welcoming and responsive. Highly recommend! I’m so glad I found them!
Brought our 4 cats here and the techs and vet are so wonderful and understanding and great with them

Don't even bother visiting another vet. I have good news for you: you don't have to bankrupt yourself with a fruitless trip to a boutique vet spa.

I grew up in a rural area with country vets. She's that kind of vet. She's practical and generous. She genuinely cares about animals and the people who bring them in. She has an uncommon curiosity. If you put a problem in front of her, I don't think she can stop herself from trying to solve it.

My cat has a medical file larger than most humans' and has seen at least 7 vets in the 6 years he's been in my care. Despite endless X-rays, blood work, poking and prodding, and pointless exploratory surgeries, no one could figure it out. We could purchase a small condo with the amount of money we've spent on this cat.

One vet diagnosed him with asthma, and we accepted that, but Dr. Sarah wasn't convinced. His health was declining, and he was so miserable that I wasn't sure he would survive, but she didn't give up on him. She literally saved his life! Turns out he just needs a neti pot and Miralax.

Also, because they see unique pets, you get to see cool animals when you drop your cat off for his enema (long story). Someone should give Paws and Feathers a TV show.

I’ve been coming to this veterinary clinic for about three years ago, and I can confidently say I love it. The staff is always friendly, professional, and very caring. Dr. Sarah is amazing — she’s knowledgeable, attentive, and truly cares about my babies

Even though it’s a bit far from my home now, it’s absolutely worth the drive.

Thank you, Paws, for consistently providing such great care and compassion!
Dr. Sarah is absolutely the best. She always goes above and beyond, and we trust her so much. I highly recommend Paws and Feathers!
Love this place. I’ve been bringing my kittens here for 2-3 months now. The doctor is so patient and knowledgeable and the staff is very kind.
Very kind with my cat🥰

I took my bird to the vet, but I truly feel like he wasn’t checked properly and his condition was not taken seriously. His beak and feet were cold, which was a clear sign something was wrong, but it didn’t seem to be noticed or addressed. There wasn’t any effort to dig deeper or make sure he was actually stable before sending us home. He was given pain medication, but shortly after, he passed away, and it’s heartbreaking knowing he may not have been okay the entire time. I regret going there and, looking back, I would definitely choose a different place next time. Please just trust your gut
Very beautiful location and very wonderful environment. They were very helpful with diagnosing our pup.
Great service here, been going for a while - kind and knowledgeable staff.

glad i randomly found this place through google! they’re always really friendly and affordable. Dr.Sarah and her staff helped day of when one of my kittens was having problems with his sutures that were done at CACC.

Best vet care in all of my experience.
The animal is always her top priority.
Goes above and beyond for them.
Excellent vet, as are the associates.

I have been taking my two cats to Paws and Feathers for around 3 years now and I cannot recommend them enough. Their staff is professional, knowledgeable, and kind. The prices are reasonable. If you are looking for a vet in the Chicago area, I highly recommend them

Saying goodbye to our sweet boy Rico was one of the hardest things we’ve ever had to do. I’m incredibly grateful to the team at our vet office for the kindness, compassion, and patience they showed us during such a painful moment.
From the very beginning, Leslie helped us during the initial intake with such empathy and understanding. When we arrived at the office, Andy greeted and guided us with kindness that immediately made us feel supported. Makenna, Rico’s nurse, treated him with so much gentleness and care, making sure he was comfortable and loved during his final moments. And a heartfelt thank you to Dr. Hadzic for the compassion, professionalism, and dignity shown to Rico and our family throughout the entire process.
The entire team was incredibly empathetic and supportive, helping us through this in ways I never even knew were possible. They gave us the time, space, and care we needed to say goodbye to our beloved boy.
In such a heartbreaking moment, their compassion truly meant the world to us. Thank you for helping Rico pass peacefully and for supporting our family with such kindness. We will always be grateful for the care you showed Rico and for the comfort you gave us. ❤️🐾
Lovely, caring people. Thanks Dr Sarah and crew!
Amazing work , Dr. Sara and her staff saved  my little baby(dog) , thank you all ❤️

Dr Sarah and the staff are wonderful to work with. They have taken good care of my parakeet a few times when she was sick.
I love that this facility is open until 10pm as I don’t have to take off work to take my pet to the vet.
Can call last minute to get my rabbits nails cut and they always get me in quick. Most of the time the next day. I’m in and out in 15 minutes
Best place I've found in the entire city to take my rabbits.

Dr. Sarah was so kind and gentle through my dogs passing. We’d been going there for years with our Bella, and I could see the compassion she had for the animals she sees, every time we went. Dr. Sarah is so kind and so good at explaining and very up front. A one of a kind vet.
Kind. Professional. Reasonably priced

I am incredibly grateful to Paws and Feather Clinic for helping my cat obtain the international health certificate in time to travel back to China.

The entire team was extremely responsible, professional, and genuinely caring. They consistently followed up with the USDA and actively pushed the process forward, which made a huge difference given how tight the timeline was. Their communication was clear and reassuring throughout, and the pricing was very reasonable with no unnecessary charges.

Beyond the excellent medical and administrative support, the clinic itself feels warm and welcoming. You can truly tell that they care deeply about both pets and their owners.

This is without question the best pet hospital I’ve ever worked with. I highly recommend Paws and Feather Clinic, especially for anyone dealing with international pet travel.
We have always had great experiences and trust Dr. Sarah with our pet!

I’m so thankful I found this emergency veterinarian hospital. They saved my cat Noni and I truly do not know what I would have done without them. I came in scared and overwhelmed with that awful feeling of not knowing what is happening to that special someone you love, and they met me with such patience, honesty, and real compassion. You can tell they genuinely care about your pet and the people who love them. Their expertise and dedication made all the difference, and I am so grateful for the care they gave mi hijo Noni. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! 🫶🫶🫶🫶
Tried calling a couple times and was put on hold immediately and left on hold! Apparently, they do not want the business.

The staff was kind to both myself and my ferret. They took really good care of his infection and explained all the follow up care. Beware though, there is a 3% transaction fee for payment by credit cards.

Paws and Feathers has been absolutely incredible with our dog and cat! The doctors and staff are really knowledgeable, explain everything clearly, and provide genuine kindness through routine visits and more complex medical issues. They’ve treated both of my pets with equal care, communicate promptly, and go above and beyond to accommodate my schedule. Our pets are healthier and happier thanks to their compassion and expertise!
The vet was great with my dog — saw us quickly for an emergency appointment, and took great care of her.

Horrible service. Careless doctor that missed a few things at the consultation. She didn’t even get close to my pet, she just looked from afar and decided she knows what’s best. Over charged. Front desk and doc had a bad rushed attitude that made me feel unwelcome. Not sure if they are racist because I looked at the comments and it seems that anyone with a Hispanic last name had a bad experience. Not sure but it seems like they just might be ignorant at good customer service. Horrible experience!!!! 0stars

I took my cat to get cremated here after she passed. They actually do aquamations which is different but I prefer that much more than traditional cremations. All of the staff is so kind. The owner (I did not get his name), he was very respectful and empathetic about everything. He explained the rundown with everything. Pricing was very reasonable. I recommend this place and give it a 10/10. Will be coming here again if cremations are needed for my other pets!
The only vet who cares about animals more than they do about money

I have been taking my iguanas here for several years already and Dr. Sarah has proven to be the most knowledgeable and intuitive as well as empathetic Vet I have seen. Also the most affordable. Her staff is also very kind. I was a prior patient of Midwest Exotics in Elmwood Park but decided to stay away from them after a detrimental mix up my iguana's prescriptions followed by poor accountability and seriousness regarding the matter. Dr. Sarah has always taken her time to make sure everything is kosher as you can tell she truly cares for animals of all kind. A friend of mine also had great things to say about Dr Sarah during a difficult time as she personally came to her house to assist with the end stage of her dog's life. Thank you Dr. Sarah 🦎❤️

Wow! What a wonderful experience.  Brought my cat in for urgent care and the staff were some of the friendliest professionals I've ever had.  They helped out my little guy and did a great job!  Also brought my son with to support and they were so kind and comforting assuring him that his cat would be just fine.  Highly recommend!

Dr. Sarah and her staff, especially Andy, Mina, An, Leslie and I’m sure others whose names I didn’t catch, are amazing. Dr. Sarah cares so deeply about our animal friends and is so thorough and careful with her treatment plans. She’s always happy to answer questions and her staff are responsive and follow up on phone calls. I’ve had to take my cat in several times the last week or two and it’s been extremely smooth. We have been going to Dr Sarah for close to 10 years and will continue going forever. I highly recommend this office!

It breaks my heart to write this post, but sometimes we need these services because it's a part of life. I looked for end of life services for a dog of mine who had been very ill. And an extensive search, I found Dr. Sarah who is amazing. I had to say goodbye to my beautiful Hunter. This was not easy, but having a kind soul to perform is underrated and she was so kind and warm. Its nice that she came out to my home so I could be with him in this time. She allowed me to spend as much time as I needed to say goodbye and explained everything that was going on. I recommend her.
Such a good experience so far, taking Frankie to the clinic for his emergency surgery. Staff is sweet and kind, and walked me through it all step by step!
They were incredible and so accommodating. I was recommended them by a close friend after they helped his cat and they very much did the same for my furbaby. Will be going here for future vet visits.

I have been looking for a new vet for some time and came across Paws and Feather. From my first initial visit, I knew this place was going to be the place to go whenever I needed anything for my cats. All the staff members are experts and treated my cats with love and care. They are very attentive and welcoming. I love working with Dr Sarah Hadzic. You can tell that she is an expert and loves what she does. We all know going to the vet can be stressful but I want to thank all the staff members for always making the experience a good and welcoming one.

I've taken all of my guinea pigs here every time they got sick and the staff has been nothing but kind. They took great care of my oldest guinea pig even during his last days. The staff are very kind and gentle with pets. I recommend taking your pets here!

My girlfriend and I came here to have our fur baby get her check up and make sure she is okay due to her feeling a little under the weather. The experience was amazing, the staff were really friendly, not just to us, but also to our cat. They were also kind enough to give us a totebag, which is only given for reviews, but still gave us a totebag non the less. Would recommend to anyone that has a fur baby that needs check ups or any care of an emergency. :)

Paws and Feathers is absolutely amazing! They are always so accommodating and willing to schedule last-minute appointments when needed. The staff is incredibly welcoming, patient, and understanding — they always take the time to answer all of our questions about both our dogs and cats. Even their billing process is smooth and stress-free. You can tell they truly care about pets and their families. Highly recommend!

I want to thank Dr Sara, Leslie and all the team that tried to help my kitty cat, Ginger to get better!
The prices are really good in comparison to other places where I went! (4 in total)
Pie and Ginger will come back and me as well :)
Thank you everybody from the office!
Dr. Sarah and her staff are fantastic. They have taken great care of my Indian Ring neck parrot. I love having an avian vet in the heart of Chicago.
Iv been coming to see Dr. Sarah for 5 years love their service, staff. They are attentive with all work and care for our pets. Thank you

Paws and Feathers took amazing care of my dog, Moose, when he needed emergency surgery. They were able to get us in quickly, and the doctor was absolutely stellar - knowledgeable, compassionate, and attentive (despite him being a bit of a demon). On top of that, the cost was much more reasonable than our regular vet. From now on, this is definitely Moose’s emergency vet. I’m so grateful for the excellent care they provided!
They help me improve the quality of my dogs life he had chronic ear infections and they helped me find a good solution that helped with my pup thank you paws and feathers 🫶🏼
Easy to schedule appointment, parking in rear is tight, have visited months ago, but this time had to ask to adjust the price for the medication as 99 was too much.

Really great vet. We really enjoy coming here for our senior cat. They do all they can to make sure you and your pet are comfortable, and they go above and beyond to make sure all of your questions are answered. Everyone on their team is lovely and cares a lot about their animals. Thank you again for always taking such great care of Willow!
My cat had ear surgery there and then eventually had to have his ear ablated. The staff there are all amazing and they treat Marshmallow like he is part of the family

The WORST! Dr. SARAH PROMISED TO DO MY DOGS X-RAYS WITHOUT NO CHARGE AND SHE DIDN’T DO THEM TO MY DOG while I was already paying for a surgery!!!!! She HAD A 6mo CANCEROUS TUMOR 3 months later  (she had just gotten surgery not even 3months ago) and NOWWW MY DOG HAD TO GET PUT DOWN AND IS NOWWW DEADDD DO TO HER NEGLECT. she could’ve caught it on the xray but since she decided not to do them now my dog is dead.
Highly recommend! Staff is very accommodating and my dog was very comfortable.
They care well my pet

My goldendoodle had a benign tumor that was infected. Paws and Feathers took her in the following day and Dr. Sara handled the complicated surgery swiftly. It is very hard to find an ER that could do this surgery in this amount of time. The manager, Andy, was very compassionate and reassuring. We were so lucky in finding Paws and Feathers.

Dr. Sara and her staff are wonderful. Compassionate, nonjudgemental, practical, responsive. Everything you would hope for in a veterinarian's office. I initially found Dr. Sara for in-home euthanasia services (she was recommended) for my 19 year old cat. She was professional but also personal and warm... Taking time to share some things about herself so the experience felt shared rather than lonely. I then transferred my other cats' care to her office because I appreciated and trusted the time she took. Paws and Feathers also really stood apart from other nearby clinics because I could almost always get an appointment the same day I called if my cats were under the weather (FIV so important to get them seen right away!). The prices at Paws and Feathers are VERY reasonable, and they only recommend tests they think are necessary. I have always let them know I am open to additional lab work, and they let me know that they already have enough information to make treatment decisions. They also explain follow-up care and make time to follow-up with appointments a few days later to see my cats' response to treatment.

In an era where corporations are scooping up veteranian clinics, I am so grateful to have Paws and Feathers available to me and my beloved pets! Everyone there is dedicated and loyal to their human and animal clients and to each other!

Truly, Thank you!

The team of Paws&Feathers are absolute experts with so much love and passion for their work, their patients and the human families.
Expert surgeon and team saved our baby boy’s life! Without their expertise and a very fair cost offer we would not sit here together today.
Paws&Feathers is just as capable as any of the big clinics but focuses on the necessary costs, rather than fancy coffee in the lobby.
We highly recommend this hardworking team and their magical hands - may many animals and humans walk out of their doors happy and healthy! ✨

Called about my cat and they promptly made an appointment for that day so I wouldn’t have to pay the emergency fee. Dr. Sarah Hadzic was phenomenal and so was her vet tech! I paid $95 for the exam, $325 for X-rays, and then additional for medicine with no insurance. Very fair pricing and exceptional care.
I really liked Dr. Sara. However, lately every appointment I had has been canceled and rescheduled. I don't go to them anymore because I don't like people not respecting other people's time.
DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE! No one at the front desk for a while. People who work with animals should actually care about them. These people don’t care and shouldn’t be in business.
I had to bring my dog in for an emergency situation. I was extremely happy with the care that we received. The vet was so caring, and honest. I think I might make them my regular vet place.

5/18/25 I've been bringing my cats here for several years and have only good things to say about this clinic. They receive the most upstanding, emphatic, top-notch care from Dr. Sarah Hadzic DVM, PH.D.                             I recently brought my cat Savitar here in March of this year for what I thought was an emergency, and the clinic got me in the same day. I really appreciate them taking my concerns seriously and accommodating me so quickly.                                                            Aaron, the vet technician, is wonderful and a pleasure to work with as well. Both he and Dr. Hadzic took the time to answer all of my questions and treated my cat with compassion. Without skipping a beat, Dr.Hadzic knew what was "wrong" with my cat, almost instantly.                  Their new location at 4472 N Elston is a lot larger than their old one at 3674 N. Elston. It's clean and spacious, and I appreciate the large waiting area. I have 100% faith in their expertise and won't bring my cats anywhere else. Thank you, Aaron and Dr. Hadzic!

DO NOT BRING YOUR PETS HERE! I don't like is that they have you sitting in a room for a hour without giving updates, and your bill keeps going up, without doctor explaining anything, dog came out worst than he went in, GAVE MY DOG A PRESCRIPTION and all of a sudden he can't walk on his own and not eating Avoid Avoid Avoid
Kind, professional,  given adequate time and explanations.

I appreciate the quick response and open availability other places had walt times of two weeks or would only do a visual inspection of my pitbull because she was loud . This was really professional and understanding of my dogs needs
And the compassion they displayed at the end of my Roxy's life will always stick with me I honestly felt they cared about my family's grift thank you for all your help

I took my senior cat in to Paws and Feathers after my daughter had taken her cat hereto be treated in the past. I have never felt more disgusted by a Vets actions before. I did not feel like there was any compassion for my baby. He had an abscess according to Dr Sarah but was only given an antibiotic shot. A week later the swollen eye began to bleed. I was instructed to email her pictures of the eye , not to bring him back in. To sum this up, I took my furbaby somewhere else where we were both treated like we mattered. He was given liquid antibiotics and pain meds and an ointment for the eye, to clear up the infection before surgery. Which she obviously was not going to do. I WILL NEVER STEP FOOT IN THIS PLACE AGAIN NOR WILL I RECOMMEND IT TO ANYONE. Seems like at this place if you don’t have a lot of money you are basically disregarded.

This place is ridiculous…my dog was having oral issues-we went into the appointment and were quoted us over $3,000 to do dental work  on our dog and they started her on antibiotics and some painkillers that didn’t seem to work. Thank goodness we went somewhere else for a second opinion and my poor fur baby ended up having aggressive cancer eating away at her jaw. Clearly they didn't do their job during the exam. How sad…would never go here!

We brought our cat here for a second opinion. She was diagnosed with cancer and the first vet was vague about our prospects - she was vaguely suggesting surgery but also said the chances of survival or full recovery are not great. Dr Sarah took one good look and said very compassionately that we shouldn’t put our cat through surgery. She explained why, she explained what we can expect over the next few weeks, and when to come back. She gave us painkillers and told us what to watch out for. I was grateful that she was willing to be clear and straightforward about how we should proceed to make out cat’s last few weeks as good as possible.

Please if you have rats do not bring them here! The pricing is insane for exotic animals, I can not speak for cat and dog care but for a minimal procedure (teeth trimming) with sedation for a single rat weighing less than a pound was well over $500… there are better and more affordable/knowledgeable places in the area to receive proper care for your rats. Staff was nice and respectful none the less so I do appreciate the workers this is not against yall.

I love paws and feathers so much, I cannot recommend them enough. Dr. Sarah is so kind and I love all their staff. You and your pet will be treated with kindness and high quality vet care. I won’t take my cat anywhere else.

If I can give 10 ⭐️ I will go for it !!! First time here , call,  Dr.Sara ,  she accepted me on Saturday , with only day ahead call !! She cheek my dog !! She knew what happened and she take  care of it!! I see some people give a some bad  reviews!!!  But definitely i didn’t see anything close to it , or anything what people been mention of the bad reviews!!!!  Thanks again  team !!!!!!!
I can’t say enough good things about paws and feathers!! The whole staff is kind and attentive, and I always feel at ease knowing that my cat is in good hands when she’s there.

I had the most horrendous experience at this animal hospital, and I honestly wouldn’t trust them with my pet’s care. The receptionist was the only decent part of the visit, and that’s saying a lot considering how terrible everything else was. The doctors were completely unprofessional and didn’t seem to care about my pet at all. They rushed through everything, didn’t answer my questions properly, and acted like they were doing me a favor by even seeing my animal. I expected a lot more from a place that’s supposed to care for animals, but instead, it felt like they were just trying to push me through as quickly as possible to get to the next patient.

I would never bring my pet back here, and I would warn others to stay far, far away. If the doctors were as competent as the receptionist, maybe this place wouldn’t be such a disaster. Avoid this place at all costs

I want to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Sarah Hadzic and the entire team at Paws and Feathers Veterinary Clinic for their exceptional care and compassion during a challenging time. When my cat ingested plastic, leading to a gastrointestinal blockage, I was initially quoted over $10,000 for the necessary procedure. However, Dr. Hadzic and her team provided the surgery at a significantly more affordable rate, ensuring my beloved pet received the treatment he needed. Their dedication and empathy have been truly invaluable, and I cannot thank them enough for their support.

I'm sorry to write this but please don't take your pets here. The staff is friendly enough, but that's about it. Very unsanitary, smelly, hairy etc. Staff member didn't even use gloves when examining my dog's infected and bleeding wound, then went and touched things on the counter/ equipment/ other devices/ doorknobs, etc without even washing hands. It was disgusting. My dog left with a dirty and actively bleeding wound, with very unclear advice on how to proceed. Also they improperly treated an ear infection a separate time for which I ended up having to take her to another vet as it had worsened significantly since taking her to paws and feathers. I remember having a slightly more positive experience here when Dr. Sarah was around, but the past several times she has no longer been there. The new vet seems very confused and is very inconsistent with explanations, diagnoses, prescriptions etc. He did not address my questions and concerns well at all. I felt like he wasn't listening to my concerns/was quite dismissive, and at the same time very unclear and contradictory with his explanations. I will not be back again.
Dr Sarah and her team are fantastic - timely, knowledgeable, tender in difficult moments, and helpful. Would recommend to friends.
Make sure to request appointments with Dr Sarah.
Thank you Dr. Sara and all the staff at paws and feathers for always being so compassionate and taking such good care of my boy Ralphie. You have always come through for us in emergency situations.
Thanks to the teams at Paws and feathers Emergency Hospital. That day i had an emergency for my dog who was sick and they took care of my dog well.

This place needs to be shut down, stay away and don’t take your animals here. Our family’s parrot passed away yesterday after she was taken to the Paws and Feathers ER. The parrot came with one issue and after treatment left with broken bones and bruises all over her body. Who knows what they did to her there. The next day our parrot was taken to the other vet clinic, where they said that she had really bad fractures and was barely breathing.
